functions.name: WillSpawnObject
functions.docs: Returns whether this binding type will spawn an object in the current context. This will be true for Spawnables always, and true for Replaceables in Editor.

functions.name: GetCustomBindingPriority
functions.docs:
@return Custom binding priority in order to sort the list of custom binding types.
If several custom binding types support the creation of bindings from the same object types, the one with the highest priority will be picked.

functions.name: GetDesiredBindingName
functions.docs: Optional method that can be overridden to return a desired name for the binding. This may be used by sequencer to name the possessable containing the binding.

functions.name: AsSpawnable
functions.docs:
For custom bindings inheriting from UMovieSceneSpawnableBindingBase, returns this object cast to UMovieSceneSpawnableBindingBase.
For custom bindings inheriting from UMovieSceneReplaceableBinding, returns the inner UMovieSceneSpawnableBindingBase* in editor, or nullptr in runtime.

functions.name: SetupDefaults
functions.signature: SetupDefaults(Target, Spawned Object, Object Binding Id, Owner Movie Scene)
functions.docs: Called by Sequencer upon creating a new custom binding or converting a binding to use this type. Can be used by custom binding types to add required track types, etc.

functions.name: GetBindingTrackCustomIconOverlay
functions.docs: Allows the custom binding to optionally provide a custom icon overlay for the object binding track.

functions.name: GetBindingTrackIconTooltip
functions.docs: Allows the custom binding to optionally provide a custom tooltip to show when hovering over the icon area in the object binding track.

functions.name: SupportsConversionFromBinding
functions.docs: Called by UI code to see if this custom binding type supports conversions from the presented binding, including any current bound or spawned object as reference.

functions.name: CreateCustomBindingFromBinding
functions.signature: CreateCustomBindingFromBinding(Target, Binding Reference, Source Object, Owner Movie Scene)
functions.docs: Called during binding conversion to create a new binding of this type from a selected binding, if supported.

functions.name: CanConvertToPossessable
functions.signature: CanConvertToPossessable(Target, Guid, Template ID, Shared Playback State)
functions.docs: Called by UI code to see if this custom binding supports converting to a possessable.

functions.name: OnBindingAddedOrChanged
functions.docs: Called by UI code when the binding has recently been added or modified in the case anything needs to be initialized or modified based on this.
